== Notes ==
* This skill will disable ''all'' of the target's elite skills.
** Players can have multiple elites by copying skills (e.g. using [[Arcane Larceny]] or a [[Signet of Capture]]). In addition, several [[monster skill]]s can also capture elites.
** A small number of [[NPC]]s have [[:Category:NPCs with multiple elite skills|multiple elites]].
